AnyBIC.name: Any BIC
AnyBIC.definition: Identification of the party expressed as a BIC.

ProprietaryIdentification.name: Proprietary Identification
ProprietaryIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier, as assigned to the party using a proprietary identification scheme.

NameAndAddress.name: Name And Address
NameAndAddress.definition: Name and address of the party.

IdentificationPresenceRule.definition: If AnyBIC is absent or NameAndAddress is absent then ProprietaryIdentification must be present.
